title: vtc: 'vtc' dataType prerequisite misstated
description: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:1448, draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md:79 and draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md:404 imply ChatStreamEnable with 'vtc' works whenever chat-wss is present; chat-wss also requires urn:ietf:params:jmap:vtc:websocket. draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md:404 still says 'calls in which the user participates' instead of 'current participant'.
close_reason: vtc-00 and vtc-wss state the 'vtc' dataType needs both WebSocket capabilities; 'current participant' wording.
